name: Greater Nightmare

items.name: Smoke
items.text:
20 feet.

The nightmare continually exhales black smoke. Creatures within the aura are Concealed to those outside it, and creatures outside the aura are concealed to creatures within it. Nightmares and their riders can see through this smoke.

A creature that begins its turn in the area must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude save save or be Sickened 2. It's then temporarily immune to being sickened by the smoke for 1 minute. This is an inhaled poison, and the nightmare and its rider are immune to it.

items.name: Flaming Gallop
items.text: The nightmare Strides or Flies up to triple its Speed. Its hooves burst with intense flame, dealing 6d6 fire damage with a DC 30 basic Reflex save save to each creature other than the nightmare's rider that the nightmare moves adjacent to during its gallop. Each creature can be affected only once during a single use of Flaming Gallop.

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Large or smaller, hoof, DC 30 basic Reflex save

---

text:
The enormous greater nightmare is valued for its ability to invade other realities with its rider.

---

Nightmares are flaming equine harbingers of death.
